modules.name: GTDefs
modules.source:
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Powerset

namespace GT

/-- Edge sets: ordered pairs (u, v), read as the edge {u, v}. Hosts list each edge once, with u < v. -/
abbrev Edges := Finset (ℕ × ℕ)

/-- No three edges (a, b), (b, c), (a, c). -/
def TriangleFree (S : Edges) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ S, ∀ f ∈ S, ∀ g ∈ S, ¬ (e.1 = g.1 ∧ e.2 = f.1 ∧ f.2 = g.2)

instance (S : Edges) : Decidable (TriangleFree S) := by
  unfold TriangleFree; infer_instance

end GT

modules.name: HSDefs
modules.source:
import GTDefs

namespace HS

/-- History predicate: every pair is listed as (u, v) with u < v. -/
def Simple (S : GT.Edges) : Prop := ∀ e ∈ S, e.1 < e.2

/-- History predicate: every endpoint is below 8. -/
def Bounded8 (S : GT.Edges) : Prop := ∀ e ∈ S, e.1 < 8 ∧ e.2 < 8

instance (S : GT.Edges) : Decidable (Simple S) := by unfold Simple; infer_instance
instance (S : GT.Edges) : Decidable (Bounded8 S) := by unfold Bounded8; infer_instance

end HS

modules.source:
import GTDefs
import HSDefs
set_option linter.unusedVariables false

namespace HSConj
/-- Generated conjecture `down_tf` (history). -/
def down_tf : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (T : GT.Edges) (h1 : T ⊆ S) (h2 : GT.TriangleFree S), GT.TriangleFree T
/-- Generated conjecture `down_simple` (history). -/
def down_simple : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (T : GT.Edges) (h1 : T ⊆ S) (h2 : HS.Simple S), HS.Simple T
/-- Generated conjecture `down_bounded` (history). -/
def down_bounded : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (T : GT.Edges) (h1 : T ⊆ S) (h2 : HS.Bounded8 S), HS.Bounded8 T
/-- Generated conjecture `inter_tf` (history). -/
def inter_tf : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (T : GT.Edges) (h1 : GT.TriangleFree S), GT.TriangleFree (S ∩ T)
/-- Generated conjecture `inter_simple` (history). -/
def inter_simple : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (T : GT.Edges) (h1 : HS.Simple S), HS.Simple (S ∩ T)
end HSConj

modules.name: RCDefs
modules.source:
import GTDefs
import HSDefs

namespace RC

/-- Recovered by typed anti-unification of HSConj.down_bounded, HSConj.down_simple, HSConj.down_tf. -/
def C0 (P0 : GT.Edges -> Prop) : Prop := (∀ (x0 : @GT.Edges), (∀ (x1 : @GT.Edges), (∀ (x2 : (@LE.le @GT.Edges (@Preorder.toLE @GT.Edges (@PartialOrder.toPreorder @GT.Edges (@Finset.instPartialOrder (@Prod @Nat @Nat)))) x1 x0)), (∀ (x3 : (P0 x0)), (P0 x1)))))

end RC

modules.source:
import GTDefs
import HSDefs

import RCDefs
set_option linter.unusedVariables false

namespace RCConj
/-- Generated conjecture `instance_down_bounded` (generated:reification-check). -/
def instance_down_bounded : Prop := @HSConj.down_bounded = @RC.C0 @HS.Bounded8
/-- Generated conjecture `instance_down_simple` (generated:reification-check). -/
def instance_down_simple : Prop := @HSConj.down_simple = @RC.C0 @HS.Simple
/-- Generated conjecture `instance_down_tf` (generated:reification-check). -/
def instance_down_tf : Prop := @HSConj.down_tf = @RC.C0 @GT.TriangleFree
/-- Generated conjecture `gen_concept_inter` (generated:generic-over-concept). -/
def gen_concept_inter : Prop := ∀ (P : GT.Edges → Prop) (h : RC.C0 P) (S : GT.Edges) (T : GT.Edges) (h1 : P S), P (S ∩ T)
/-- Generated conjecture `gen_concept_sdiff` (generated:generic-over-concept). -/
def gen_concept_sdiff : Prop := ∀ (P : GT.Edges → Prop) (h : RC.C0 P) (S : GT.Edges) (T : GT.Edges) (h1 : P S), P (S \ T)
/-- Generated conjecture `gen_concept_filter` (generated:generic-over-concept). -/
def gen_concept_filter : Prop := ∀ (P : GT.Edges → Prop) (h : RC.C0 P) (S : GT.Edges) (q : ℕ × ℕ → Bool) (h1 : P S), P (S.filter fun e => q e)
/-- Generated conjecture `gen_concept_erase` (generated:generic-over-concept). -/
def gen_concept_erase : Prop := ∀ (P : GT.Edges → Prop) (h : RC.C0 P) (S : GT.Edges) (e : ℕ × ℕ) (h1 : P S), P (S.erase e)
end RCConj

modules.name: G4Defs
modules.source:
import GTDefs

namespace G4

/-- Domain contract (c4_host_v2): u and v are joined in S, in either orientation. -/
def adj (S : GT.Edges) (u v : ℕ) : Prop := (u, v) ∈ S ∨ (v, u) ∈ S

instance (S : GT.Edges) (u v : ℕ) : Decidable (adj S u v) := by
  unfold adj; infer_instance

def verts (S : GT.Edges) : Finset ℕ := S.image Prod.fst ∪ S.image Prod.snd

/-- No 4-cycle a-b-c-d-a with a ≠ c and b ≠ d. -/
def C4Free (S : GT.Edges) : Prop :=
  ∀ a ∈ verts S, ∀ b ∈ verts S, ∀ c ∈ verts S, ∀ d ∈ verts S,
    a ≠ c → b ≠ d → ¬ (adj S a b ∧ adj S b c ∧ adj S c d ∧ adj S d a)

instance (S : GT.Edges) : Decidable (C4Free S) := by
  unfold C4Free; infer_instance

end G4

modules.name: FFDefs
modules.source:
import GTDefs
import G4Defs

namespace FF

/-- Fresh predicate: no loops. -/
def LoopFree (S : GT.Edges) : Prop := ∀ e ∈ S, e.1 ≠ e.2

/-- Fresh predicate: distinct pairs share no endpoint. -/
def Matching (S : GT.Edges) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ S, ∀ f ∈ S, e ≠ f → e.1 ≠ f.1 ∧ e.1 ≠ f.2 ∧ e.2 ≠ f.1 ∧ e.2 ≠ f.2

/-- Fresh predicate that is not down-closed. -/
def NonEmpty (S : GT.Edges) : Prop := S.Nonempty

instance (S : GT.Edges) : Decidable (LoopFree S) := by unfold LoopFree; infer_instance
instance (S : GT.Edges) : Decidable (Matching S) := by unfold Matching; infer_instance
instance (S : GT.Edges) : Decidable (NonEmpty S) := by unfold NonEmpty; infer_instance

end FF

modules.source:
import GTDefs
import HSDefs
import HSConj
import RCDefs

import G4Defs

set_option linter.unusedVariables false

namespace FFCConj
/-- Generated conjecture `inst_concept_loopfree` (generated:concept-instance). -/
def inst_concept_loopfree : Prop := RC.C0 FF.LoopFree
/-- Generated conjecture `inst_concept_matching` (generated:concept-instance). -/
def inst_concept_matching : Prop := RC.C0 FF.Matching
/-- Generated conjecture `inst_concept_c4free` (generated:concept-instance). -/
def inst_concept_c4free : Prop := RC.C0 G4.C4Free
/-- Generated conjecture `inst_concept_nonempty` (generated:concept-instance). -/
def inst_concept_nonempty : Prop := RC.C0 FF.NonEmpty
def inst_concept_nonempty_negation : Prop := ¬ inst_concept_nonempty
/-- Generated conjecture `concept_loopfree_inter` (fresh-family). -/
def concept_loopfree_inter : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (T : GT.Edges) (h1 : FF.LoopFree S), FF.LoopFree (S ∩ T)
/-- Generated conjecture `concept_loopfree_sdiff` (fresh-family). -/
def concept_loopfree_sdiff : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (T : GT.Edges) (h1 : FF.LoopFree S), FF.LoopFree (S \ T)
/-- Generated conjecture `concept_loopfree_filter` (fresh-family). -/
def concept_loopfree_filter : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (q : ℕ × ℕ → Bool) (h1 : FF.LoopFree S), FF.LoopFree (S.filter fun e => q e)
/-- Generated conjecture `concept_loopfree_erase` (fresh-family). -/
def concept_loopfree_erase : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (e : ℕ × ℕ) (h1 : FF.LoopFree S), FF.LoopFree (S.erase e)
/-- Generated conjecture `concept_matching_inter` (fresh-family). -/
def concept_matching_inter : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (T : GT.Edges) (h1 : FF.Matching S), FF.Matching (S ∩ T)
/-- Generated conjecture `concept_matching_sdiff` (fresh-family). -/
def concept_matching_sdiff : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (T : GT.Edges) (h1 : FF.Matching S), FF.Matching (S \ T)
/-- Generated conjecture `concept_matching_filter` (fresh-family). -/
def concept_matching_filter : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (q : ℕ × ℕ → Bool) (h1 : FF.Matching S), FF.Matching (S.filter fun e => q e)
/-- Generated conjecture `concept_matching_erase` (fresh-family). -/
def concept_matching_erase : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (e : ℕ × ℕ) (h1 : FF.Matching S), FF.Matching (S.erase e)
/-- Generated conjecture `concept_c4free_inter` (fresh-family). -/
def concept_c4free_inter : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (T : GT.Edges) (h1 : G4.C4Free S), G4.C4Free (S ∩ T)
/-- Generated conjecture `concept_c4free_sdiff` (fresh-family). -/
def concept_c4free_sdiff : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (T : GT.Edges) (h1 : G4.C4Free S), G4.C4Free (S \ T)
/-- Generated conjecture `concept_c4free_filter` (fresh-family). -/
def concept_c4free_filter : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (q : ℕ × ℕ → Bool) (h1 : G4.C4Free S), G4.C4Free (S.filter fun e => q e)
/-- Generated conjecture `concept_c4free_erase` (fresh-family). -/
def concept_c4free_erase : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (e : ℕ × ℕ) (h1 : G4.C4Free S), G4.C4Free (S.erase e)
/-- Generated conjecture `concept_nonempty_inter` (fresh-family). -/
def concept_nonempty_inter : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (T : GT.Edges) (h1 : FF.NonEmpty S), FF.NonEmpty (S ∩ T)
def concept_nonempty_inter_negation : Prop := ¬ concept_nonempty_inter
/-- Generated conjecture `concept_nonempty_sdiff` (fresh-family). -/
def concept_nonempty_sdiff : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (T : GT.Edges) (h1 : FF.NonEmpty S), FF.NonEmpty (S \ T)
def concept_nonempty_sdiff_negation : Prop := ¬ concept_nonempty_sdiff
/-- Generated conjecture `concept_nonempty_filter` (fresh-family). -/
def concept_nonempty_filter : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (q : ℕ × ℕ → Bool) (h1 : FF.NonEmpty S), FF.NonEmpty (S.filter fun e => q e)
def concept_nonempty_filter_negation : Prop := ¬ concept_nonempty_filter
/-- Generated conjecture `concept_nonempty_erase` (fresh-family). -/
def concept_nonempty_erase : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (e : ℕ × ℕ) (h1 : FF.NonEmpty S), FF.NonEmpty (S.erase e)
def concept_nonempty_erase_negation : Prop := ¬ concept_nonempty_erase
end FFCConj

  try unfold FF.Matching at *
